verdict.rationale: Code can leave the platform: the CLI eject command downloads an app's frontend code and backend resources into a local project, GitHub sync keeps that code in your own repo, and the SDK lets you build your own frontend that uses Base44 as a backend service. However, the ejected project still gets a Base44 app ID, the backend stays a managed Base44 service, and a community comment notes the database is built into the platform rather than kept externally, so fully self-hosting is not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deployment of the generated app to an external host, self-hosting of the backend and database, independent or hands-on confirmation of running outside Base44.
